title: parallel coordinates view
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate parallel coordinates chart with multiple float arrays on a table using vtkChartParallelCoordinates and vtkContextActor.

**dataset → chart → context_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkChartParallelCoordinates](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkChartParallelCoordinates.html) — parallel coordinates chart.
- [vtkContextActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContextActor.html) — provides a 2D scene for context items.
- [vtkFloatArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFloatArray.html) — stores an array of floating-point values.
- [vtkTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTable.html) — table data structure for chart input.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
